sources.title: ‘This wasn’t an easy decision,' Cloudflare CEO said as it cuts over 1,100 jobs globally - BusinessToday
sources.description: Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said that some existing jobs may no longer fit the kind of work Cloudflare expects to prioritise going forward.

sources.title: Cloudflare Slashes 20% of Workforce Despite Record Revenue
sources.description: Cloudflare is cutting 20% of its workforce as AI reshapes its business model, despite record revenue and continued growth expectations.

sources.title: Cloudflare to Layoff Over 1100 Employees Amid Shift to ‘AI-First’ Model – Outlook Business
sources.description: Cloudflare will lay off over 1,100 employees, about 20% of its global workforce, as it restructures for the agentic AI era. CEO Matthew Prince says the move isn’t about cost cutting but reshaping workflows as AI usage surges 600%. Learn what’s driving the decision and the generous severance, healthcare, and equity packages for departing staff.
